vision: The V1 harness is built and validated. iter-1 prompt engineering (rubric + staged CoT + router probability) moved D1 from 0.40 to 0.60 and D3 from 0.13 to 0.20 on Claude Sonnet 4.6 production data (n=20). D6 stable at 0.85. 5/6 gates pass at n=20. Next: diagnose D3 failure modes (EXP-FORENSICS-TAG) and validate at n=50 (iter-2).
direction: Two-tier improvement: Tier 1 (iter-1/2) — method changes (prompt, context injection) with loop frozen. Tier 2 (triggered by plateau) — loop architecture becomes variable. tier_2_pivot NOT triggered (ΔD1=+0.20, ΔD3=+0.07).

prior_phase.name: v1-build
prior_phase.summary: 11 tasks (scaffold → eval run). All done and committed. Built: GroundTruthGraph, GitContextProvider, CommitContextBuilder, AgentOrchestrator, XGBoostRouter, EvalHarness (6D), ReasoningJudge, CursorSDK provider, timestamped runs. Data leakage found and fixed post-V1.

gate.description: All six must pass simultaneously. Blocks delivery.

target.description: Quality bar for an acceptable deliverable.

acceptance_thresholds.baseline_rule: soft — emit WARNING if D1_agent < D1_always_predict_clean or D1_router_only

current_baseline.note: iter-1 production eval with Claude Sonnet 4.6. n=20 stratified (10 buggy + 10 clean). Verified by evaluator round 8.
current_baseline.key_finding: 6/10 clean commits classified HIGH (false positive problem). Agent generates plausible SUPPORTED hypotheses on clean commits.

tier_2.scope: Loop architecture: max_turns, bundle expansion, judge model split, deterministic context expansion
tier_2.trigger: Post-iter-1 n=20: ΔD3 < 0.05 AND ΔD1 < 0.10, OR EXP-FORENSICS-TAG shows >40% missing-context-likely

cycle: 1. Hypothesize: which prompt/loop change will move which dimension?
2. Implement: change orchestrator.py prompt or context assembly
3. Smoke test: run n=5 to catch regressions quickly (~5 min, ~$0.02)
4. Validate: run n=20 stratified eval to measure dimension scores (~24 min, ~$0.10)
5. Compare: check against baseline and thresholds, analyze per-commit eval JSONs
6. Decide: if gate-trending, run n=50 for statistical confidence; if flat, activate Tier 2
constraints: Oracle isolation must hold — agent never sees buggy/fix/year labels
86+ tests must pass after every change
D6 ≥ 0.70 is a hard regression guard in every eval run
Each iteration tracked as a breadcrumb with before/after scores

failure_analysis.D1_why_failing: D1=0.60 (gate 0.70). Buggy recall is good (0.80) but 6/10 clean commits classified HIGH. The rubric generates plausible SUPPORTED hypotheses on clean commits — Claude's reasoning ability works against precision. Needs clean-commit discrimination.
failure_analysis.D2_status: D2=0.15, at gate boundary. Agent still lists files analyzed rather than defect locus, but rubric (e) criterion forces correct localization on some commits.
failure_analysis.D3_status: D3=0.20, at gate boundary. Mixed: b4c933b7 gets D3=0.75 (correct classloader mechanism), but 90846b5 gets D3=0.0 (wrong root cause — binary incompat vs deadlock). Judge infra issues (JIRA no description) also cause D3=0.0.

tasks.name: Research spike: optimal investigation harness design
tasks.scope: Define investigation harness as system architecture. Research in .harness/archive/docs/spike-investigation-harness.md.

tasks.name: Prompt engineering: A+B hybrid + router prior
tasks.scope: Implemented spike §5.2 system prompt + §5.3 router_probability injection. Production-verified with Claude Sonnet 4.6: D1=0.60 (+0.20), D3=0.20 (+0.07), D6=0.85 (stable).

tasks.name: Experiment: classify D3 failure modes
tasks.scope: Tagged 8 D3≤0.25 buggy commits from Claude n=20. Result: 50% missing-context-likely (3 diff-truncation + 1 architectural-depth), 37.5% wrong-mechanism, 12.5% judge-infra. Also found 60% clean-FP rate (6/10 clean→HIGH). Decision: BOTH context expansion AND prompt refinement needed.
tasks.decision_rule: If >40% tagged missing-context-likely, prioritize EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND in iter-2 track
tasks.decision_outcome: TRIGGERED (50% > 40%). Priority order: (1) increase diff char limit, (2) add clean-commit rubric discrimination, (3) EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND, (4) EXP-JUDGE-SWAP.

tasks.name: Experiment: multi-turn A/B (max_turns 1 vs 3)
tasks.scope: n=20 stratified eval with iter-1 prompt: max_turns=1 vs max_turns=3, identical bundle.
tasks.decision_rule: If ΔD3≥0.05 or ΔD1≥0.10 with ≤60% cost increase, merge multi-turn into iter-2

tasks.name: Validate at n=50 + experiments
tasks.scope: Run n=50 stratified eval to confirm iter-1 improvements are statistically stable. All 6 gates must pass for delivery.

tasks.name: Experiment: cross-model judge vs same-model
tasks.scope: Re-score n=20 investigation reports with cross-model judge.
tasks.decision_rule: If mean D3 drops ≥0.03 or ≥3 commits flip gate status, mandate split judge before n=50

tasks.name: Experiment: deterministic context expansion
tasks.scope: n=5 smoke: (a) baseline, (b) +auto test files, (c) +blame snippets, (d) b+c.
tasks.decision_rule: If (b) or (c) lifts D3≥0.25 on ≥2/5 without D6 regression, add to context builder

tasks.name: Multi-turn investigation
tasks.scope: Enable turn 2–3 for low-confidence commits. Only if EXP-MULTITURN-AB did not already promote multi-turn to iter-2.

tasks.name: D2 localization + deterministic bundle expansion
tasks.scope: Prompt agent to distinguish defect locus from analysis scope. Integrate EXP-BUNDLE-EXPAND results if positive.

tasks.name: Experiment: Sonnet vs Opus on hard commits
tasks.scope: 10 commits with D3=0 and D6≥0.7. Run Sonnet vs Opus/reasoning model.
tasks.decision_rule: If Opus ΔD3≥0.15 on subset, consider tiered routing

risks.risk: False positives on clean commits (6/10 clean → HIGH)
risks.mitigation: EXP-FORENSICS-TAG will classify these as clean-FP. If dominant, iter-2 adds clean-commit discrimination to rubric.

risks.risk: Same-model judge inflates D3 scores — false progress signal
risks.mitigation: EXP-JUDGE-SWAP mandatory before n=50 gate declaration

risks.risk: D3 at exact gate boundary (0.20 = 0.20) — unstable
risks.mitigation: n=50 will determine whether 0.20 is real or sample variance

risks.risk: Prompt-only iteration hits ceiling on integration defects missing test/caller context
risks.mitigation: EXP-FORENSICS-TAG + Tier-2 pivot triggers activate loop experiments
